title: Strictly bounded, manually triggered, Solana-only, GMGN-only 100-wallet statistical profile batch live smoke
objective: Based on verified Chain.fm SOL address cleaning output, perform a strictly bounded, manually triggered, Solana-only, GMGN-only 100-wallet statistical profile batch live smoke. For 100 deterministically selected addresses (skipping the first 20 pilot addresses, choosing 21st-120th), fetch and normalize GMGN 7D and 30D wallet stats with rate-limiting (>=1s serial delay, <=200 total request budget), collecting only allowlisted metrics with source=gmgn, verification_status=unverified, completeness, warning/error codes, and fetchedAt watermark. Outputs are saved to external directory C:\Users\10639\chainfm_out\sol\derived\gmgn-wallet-profile-batch-100-live-smoke-001, strictly marked borrowed/unverified.
forbidden_actions: Do not call BSC, Robinhood, multichain, or any chain other than Solana.
Do not use web scraping, browser automation, Cloudflare bypass, GMGN Web pages, or non-official endpoints.
Do not execute trades, signatures, transfers, or orders.
Do not execute cron, background loops, auto-discovery, or automatic daily updates.
Do not call Helius or perform on-chain verification in this task.
Do not write to databases, Redis, queues, or production systems.
Do not print, persist, or commit API keys, private keys, raw payloads, raw errors, or full user address lists in Git.
Do not claim GMGN metrics are chain-confirmed facts, and do not use LLMs to score or explain individual wallets.
